description: Evaluation suite for working-in-notebooks skill covering Jupyter, marimo, and reproducibility workflows

task_evals.name: Convert Jupyter to Marimo
task_evals.description: Convert an existing Jupyter notebook to marimo format
task_evals.prompt: I have a Jupyter notebook called analysis.ipynb that I want to convert to marimo for better version control. How do I do this?
expected_behavior: Mentions that outputs will be recomputed
Suggests `marimo edit` to verify the conversion

task_evals.name: Make Notebook Reproducible
task_evals.description: Set up a notebook for reproducibility with seeds and dependencies
task_evals.prompt: I'm creating a data analysis notebook that uses random sampling. How can I make sure someone else can get the same results when they run it?
expected_behavior: Mentions setting random seeds (numpy, random, torch)
negative_indicators: Suggests Docker as the only solution

task_evals.name: Jupyter Magic Commands
task_evals.prompt: What are some useful Jupyter magic commands for timing code and debugging?

task_evals.name: Marimo Reactive Execution
task_evals.prompt: How does marimo's reactive execution work? If I have three cells where cell 2 depends on cell 1, and cell 3 depends on cell 2, what happens when I change cell 1?
expected_behavior: Mentions that cell 2 and cell 3 will re-run

task_evals.name: Notebook Git Best Practices
task_evals.prompt: I want to commit my Jupyter notebooks to git, but the diffs are messy and files are huge. What should I do?
negative_indicators: Says to avoid git for notebooks
